description.value:
When you take acid, cold, energy, fire, ion, kinetic, lightning, or sonic damage, you can convert some of that incoming force into a charge for your next strike. You gain resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. The first time before then that you hit with a melee attack, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the same type, and the power ends.

Cast with a power slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
